THE PRACTICAL DETAILS

Guidelines in practice

Proposed digital standards
01

Canvas

Start at 1080 × 1920 px. Use a 64 px side inset as a proposed layout guide.

02

Safe-area starting point

Reserve 250 px at the top and 350 px at the bottom. These are proposed exclusions, not universal platform rules. Preview current overlays on each placement.

03

Logo position

Use the top-left inside the content-safe area. Keep the clear-space rule around the mark.

04

Captions & motion

Keep captions high-contrast and inside the safe region. The headline and essential meaning must work in a static frame.

05

Cover frame

Check the cover in the feed and profile grid. Keep its core message within the actual visible crop.
